newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indofood announces 1.259 trln rph issue.
newsitem.headline: Indofood announces 1.259 trln rph issue.

text.p: Indonesia's largest noodle maker PT Indofood Sukses Makmur said on Thursday it has submitted a registration statement to the capital market supervisory agency (Bapepam) for a 1.259 trillion rupiah rights issue.

"PT Indofood Sukses Makmur submitted a registration statement to Bapepam (Capital Market Supervisory Agency) for a Rights Issue offering with 4:1 terms at the price of 3,300 rupiah-4,000 rupiah per share," Indofood said in a statement.
Indofood, which belongs to Indonesia's largest conglomerate the Salim Group, said it expected to receive proceeds of the rights issue in May 1997.

The proceeds, expected to be around 1.259 trillion rupiah, would be used to acquire ten companies within the Salim Group. The companies have business interests in edible oils and fats, plantation and distribution, it said.
The planned acquisitions were expected to make a positive contribution to the firm's net income in 1997 and the succeeding years, Indofood said.

"Barring unforeseen circumstances, net profit after tax in 1997 is projected to grow more than 45 percent and earnings per share to increase almost 20 percent on a fully diluted basis," Indofood said.
